title: Ask Celerp AI a question
summary: Celerp AI answers questions about your business data and about using Celerp, in your own language. Eligible free accounts with a verified email address receive free questions, and a paid plan adds more.

steps.text: Open {ai} from the sidebar. Without a Celerp account it shows example conversations and a {create} button; eligible free accounts with a verified email address receive AI questions at no cost.
With an account, type a question in your own language in the box at the bottom and send it; you can also drop a receipt, PDF or spreadsheet onto the box for the assistant to read.
The {plan} card on this page lists what a paid plan adds over the free questions: more monthly questions, batch invoice processing, and letting the assistant create records for you.
